name: Linear probe (round-6) on round-5 BT priors
rationale: Round-6 result: a single Linear(512→1) probe trained on MuQ-MuLan embeddings via RankNet pairwise margin loss against round-5 LLM-derived BT priors. Beats V11 by +8.6 pp pairwise agreement (71.1% vs 62.5% via 5-fold CV). Drop-in compatible with the existing polar IntensityAxis runtime — no code changes.
intensity_formula: l2_normalize(LinearProbe(MuQ-MuLan-emb)); bias dropped (does not affect ranking)
